armySpecialRules.name: BLOOD RAGE
armySpecialRules.description: Whenever a model with this special rule makes a successful charge (including Counter-Charge, Pursuit and Overrun), they are subject to Frenzy in the following round of close combat and count each of their ranks as double for the purpose of Steadfast.

armySpecialRules.name: FUR CLOAK
armySpecialRules.description: A fur cloak gives the wearer the Natural Armour (6+) special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: KAOSFAENIR
magicItems.description: No Magical Ward saves may be taken against wounds caused by Kaosfaenir. In addition, for each unsaved Wound a model suffers from this weapon, they must pass a Strength test or be instantly slain.

magicItems.name: THE SWAYING SPEAR
magicItems.description: All close combat and missile attacks made with the Swaying Spear Hit always Hit on a 2+ and have the Heroic Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: THE CRUSHER
magicItems.description: Attacks made with the Crusher have the Lightning Attacks and Multiple Wounds (D6) special rules.

magicItems.name: SKAR'S KRAKEN-KILLER
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Armour Piercing (3) special rule. In addition; once per game, at the start of any round of close combat, the bearer can choose to ignore all damage suffered for the duration of this close combat phase, as long as they do not flee from combat.

magicItems.name: TYRFANG
magicItems.description: Tyrfang gives it wielder +1 To Hit in close combat, and the Ignores Armour Saves and Flaming Attacks special rules. If the wielder does not kill at least one opponent in each round of close combat he is in, they suffer 1 Wound which Ignores Armour saves and Regeneration saves as the sword strikes its wielder instead.

magicItems.name: NAEGLING
magicItems.description: The wielder of Naegling gains the Mighty Blow (2) special rule and gains +2 Attacks in the first round of Combat.

magicItems.name: FLAMING AXE OF CORMAC
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength, +1 Attack and the Flaming Attacks special rule. However, if they ever flee during the battle, the weapon loses all its effects.

magicItems.name: CHIEFTAIN'S BLADE
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength. In addition, they gain +1 To Hit while fighting in a challenge.

magicItems.name: GARMR & GORMR
magicItems.description: One enemy model of your choice in base contact with the wielder loses 1 Attack. In addition, a challenge issued by the wielder cannot be refused.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF RAGE
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Frenzy special rule. For every natural 6 when rolling To Hit, the wielder may immediately make an additional Attack.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR-RIPPER OF SKORLM
magicItems.description: Enemies wounded by this weapon must re-roll successful armour saves.

magicItems.name: TROLL-FANG DAGGER
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF BEOWULF
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains +1 Wound and the Regeneration (4+) special rule

magicItems.name: BERSERKER HELM
magicItems.description: This armour gives the wearer a 6+ armour save and the Frenzy special rule. In additional, enemy models must re-roll successful To Wound rolls against them.

magicItems.name: ANCIENT FROST-WYRM SCALE
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Ice Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: MIGHTY SERPENT'S SCALEMAIL
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Always Strike First special rule.

magicItems.name: GJERMUNDBU MAIL SHIRT
magicItems.description: All attacks against the wearer of this armour cannot exceed Strength 4, any excess Strength is Ignored.

magicItems.name: HUSKARL PLATES
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains +1 Toughness.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF SVALINN
magicItems.description: For each successful armour save or Parry save roll of a natural 6 that the bearer makes, all models attacking suffer -1 To Hit until the end of the next turn. In addition, the bearer gains the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: REAVER'S HELM
magicItems.description: This armour gives the wearer a 6+ armour save and the Ambushers special rule. In addition, any enemy unit that gets destroyed by them in close combat or from pursuit is worth +100 Victory Points.

magicItems.name: THE GLEAMING TORC
magicItems.description: A model equipped with the Gleaming Torc adds +1 to their leadership. In addition, all enemy models in base contact with the wearer must pass a Leadership test at the start of each close combat phase. If failed, they will be unable to attack this turn.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF THE CARRION CROW
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Talisman of the Carrion Crow has the Regeneration (5+) and Poisoned Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF THE SOARING EAGLE
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Talisman of the Soaring Eagle has the Magic Resistance (2) special rule. In addition, the bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save against Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: IDUNN'S APPLE
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule. If owner rolls a 1 when making their Regeneration save, they lose this special rule for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: THE WEB OF WYRD
magicItems.description: The Wizard may re-roll any single D6 when casting or dispelling once per turn.

magicItems.name: BONE OF ULLR
magicItems.description: At the start of each of your Magic phases, choose any of the eight Winds of Magic and roll 2D6; the result is the spell they receive and may use for the remainder of this Magic phase, even if this spell would normally be unavailable to them.

magicItems.name: HENBANE POTION
magicItems.description: The Wizard may use this item at the start of any Magic phase. To do so, roll a D6; on a 2+, they gain D3 Power or Dispel dice. If a 1 is rolled, they lose one Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: GIRDLE OF MIGHT
magicItems.description: The Girdle of Might doubles the Strength characteristic of anyone wearing it.

magicItems.name: THE HOLLERING HORN
magicItems.description: The Horn can be used at the start of any of your turns. When the Horn is sounded, all enemy units within 12" must take an immediate Panic test. After this, all friendly units with the Blood Rage special rule within 12" will move towards the nearest foe using the Random Movement (D6) rule.

magicItems.name: HRUNGNIR'S HEART
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of each round of close combat. Take a Leadership test; if successful the bearer and all models in their unit gain +1 To Hit this turn. Alternatively, you can force one enemy unit in base contact to take a Leadership test; if failed that unit suffer -1 To Hit this turn.

magicItems.name: VEGVISIR
magicItems.description: The bearer and any unit they join may re-roll failed charge and pursuit distances.

magicItems.name: VIAL OF TROLL BLOOD
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any round of close combat. The bearer gains the Unbreakable special rule for the duration of the turn. If they are in a unit, the unit may still break and flee as normal, while the model remains in combat.

magicItems.name: WOLF-TEETH AMULET
magicItems.description: The model gains the Devastating Charge special rule. However, they must always pursue a fleeing enemy.

magicItems.name: RAVEN BANNER
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 12" of this standard gain the Immunity (Fear/Panic) special rule.

magicItems.name: SKALLAGRIM'S BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Mighty Blow (1) special rule when charging or counter-charging. In addition, enemy units cannot get the Outnumber bonus against them.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE VALKYRIE
magicItems.description: This item contains a conveyance spell that targets the unit carrying this standard. The unit may immediately make a Fly (10) move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase.

magicItems.name: SEA RAIDER'S CREST
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the the Fear special rule. If the unit charges an enemy unit into their flank or rear, it gains the Terror special rule against their target for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE BAYING HOUND
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Vanguard special rule.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE FEARLESS LEADER
sagas.description: The character and any unit they are with have the Cold- Blooded special rule.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE EVER-VIGILANT
sagas.description: The character gains the Parry (6+) special rule, and enemies suffer -1 To Hit the model in close combat.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE RELENTLESS WARRIOR
sagas.description: The character gains +1 Attack for every enemy model in base contact with them when it is their turn to strike, up to a maximum of +3.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE SHINING HERO
sagas.description: The model gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE BEASTSLAYER
sagas.description: The model gains Immunity (Terror). In addition, they gain +1 To Hit and To Wound when fighting War Beasts, Monstrous Beasts or Monsters in close combat.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE ETERNAL WARRIOR
sagas.description: Once this model is reduced to 0 Wounds, roll a D6; on a 4+ the model remains fighting with 1 Wound. This has no effect against Killing Blow or other attacks that would instantly kill the model.

sagas.name: SAGA OF THE GLORIOUS HUNTER
sagas.description: After deployment, but before the first turn begins, select a single character or monster in your opponent’s army. This is the character’s primary quarry. The character may re-roll all failed To Hit and To Wound rolls against his primary quarry in close combat and with missile attacks.
